cards.ex: Everyone deserves a fair shake in life, no matter where they come from.
cards.exUz: Har bir inson hayotda qayerdan kelib chiqishidan qat'i nazar, adolatli imkoniyatga ega bo'lishi kerak.
cards.uzDef: Kimdirga adolatli va teng imkoniyat berish.

cards.ex: I had to bend the rules a little to get him the job.
cards.exUz: Unga ish topish uchun qoidalarni biroz buzishimga to'g'ri keldi.

cards.ex: The deal seemed completely above board.
cards.exUz: Kelishuv butunlay halol ko'rinardi.

cards.ex: You need to play fair if you want to be respected.
cards.exUz: Hurmatga sazovor bo'lishni istasangiz, halol o'ynashingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Qoidalarga rioya qilib, adolatli o'ynamoq yoki ishlamoq.

cards.ex: He thought he could get away with cheating on the test.
cards.exUz: U imtihonda aldash bilan jazodan qutulishiga ishondi.

cards.ex: You can't take the law into your own hands; you have to call the police.
cards.exUz: Siz qonunni o'z qo'lingizga ololmaysiz; siz politsiyaga qo'ng'iroq qilishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Qonunni o'z qo'liga olish va o'zboshimchalik bilan harakat qilish.

cards.ex: We need to create a level playing field for all students.
cards.exUz: Biz barcha talabalar uchun teng sharoit yaratishimiz kerak.

cards.ex: They were accused of cooking the books to hide their losses.
cards.exUz: Ular zararlarini yashirish uchun hisobotlarni soxtalashtirishda ayblangan.

cards.ex: Finally, justice is served after all these years.
cards.exUz: Nihoyat, shuncha yildan keyin adolat qaror topdi.

cards.ex: The teacher turned a blind eye to the student's cheating.
cards.exUz: O'qituvchi talabaning aldashiga e'tibor bermadi.
cards.uzDef: Xato yoki noto'g'ri narsaga e'tibor bermaslik.

cards.ex: He knew he was in the wrong, but he wouldn't admit it.
cards.exUz: U aybdorligini bilardi, lekin tan olmadi.

cards.ex: If you break the law, you have to pay the price.
cards.exUz: Agar qonunni buzsaiz, jazosini olishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Xato yoki noto'g'ri ish uchun javobgarlikka tortilmoq.

cards.ex: I think he got a raw deal when he was fired.
cards.exUz: Menimcha, u ishdan bo'shatilganda unga adolatli munosabatda bo'lishmadi.
cards.uzDef: Adolatsiz munosabatda bo'lish yoki adolatsiz ahvolga tushish.

cards.ex: We need to hold the company accountable for the pollution.
cards.exUz: Biz kompaniyani ifloslanish uchun javobgarlikka tortishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Kimnidir o'z harakatlari uchun javobgar qilish.

cards.ex: The rule of law is essential for a fair society.
cards.exUz: Qonun ustuvorligi adolatli jamiyat uchun muhimdir.

cards.ex: The wrongful conviction was a terrible miscarriage of justice.
cards.exUz: Noto'g'ri hukm chiqarish adolatdan dahshatli chekinish edi.

cards.ex: You can trust him; he's always on the level.
cards.exUz: Unga ishonishingiz mumkin; u doimo rostgo'y.

cards.ex: He wanted to right the wrong he had done to her.
cards.exUz: U unga qilgan xatosini tuzatmoqchi edi.

cards.ex: They acted with impunity, knowing they wouldn't be punished.
cards.exUz: Ular jazolanmasliklarini bilib, jazosiz harakat qilishdi.

cards.ex: He tried to make amends for his mistakes.
cards.exUz: U xatolari uchun to'lov to'lashga harakat qildi.

cards.ex: The justice system needs reform.
cards.exUz: Adliya tizimi islohotga muhtoj.

cards.ex: Everyone is entitled to due process under the law.
cards.exUz: Har bir inson qonun bo'yicha tegishli tartibga haqli.
cards.uzDef: Qonuniy huquqlarni himoya qiladigan tegishli tartib.

cards.ex: His moral compass always points him in the right direction.
cards.exUz: Uning axloqiy kompas doimo uni to'g'ri yo'nalishga yo'naltiradi.

cards.ex: There's a double standard when it comes to men and women in the workplace.
cards.exUz: Ish joyida erkaklar va ayollarga nisbatan ikkiyoqlama standart mavjud.

cards.ex: The victims are seeking justice for what happened to them.
cards.exUz: Jabrlanuvchilar ularga nima bo'lgani uchun adolat izlashmoqda.

cards.ex: I can sleep with a clear conscience knowing I did the right thing.
cards.exUz: Men to'g'ri ish qilganimni bilib, sof vijdon bilan uxlay olaman.
cards.uzDef: Hech qanday yomon ish qilmaganlik hissi.

cards.ex: We believe in equal opportunity for everyone, regardless of their background.
cards.exUz: Biz har bir kishiga, kelib chiqishidan qat'i nazar, teng imkoniyat berishga ishonamiz.
cards.uzDef: Har bir kishiga teng imkoniyatlar berish.

cards.ex: The new evidence tipped the scales in favor of the defendant.
cards.exUz: Yangi dalillar muvozanatni ayblanuvchining foydasiga o'zgartirdi.

cards.ex: The company was accused of unjust enrichment at the expense of its workers.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya o'z ishchilari hisobidan asoslanmagan boylik orttirishda ayblangan.

cards.ex: Equity focuses on fairness and justice by addressing different needs.
cards.exUz: Tenglik turli ehtiyojlarni qondirish orqali adolat va haqqoniylikka e'tibor qaratadi.
cards.uzDef: Har bir kishining ehtiyojlariga mos keladigan adolat.
